layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no safe entry point visible right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with the Fear & Greed Index at 27 and worsening. Bitcoin is down about 2.5% this week, and most altcoins are doing worse — some have lost 10-30% in a week. The coins that look 'cheap' on paper (like BONK or DEXE) are cheap because they're in strong downtrends with bearish chart patterns, meaning they could keep falling. There's also a major security incident — a Coldcard hardware wallet exploit has stolen nearly $89 million in Bitcoin — which is rattling confidence.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and protect your capital. None of the current setups offer a favorable risk-to-reward ratio. Wait for the fear to either intensify into capitulation (a better buying opportunity) or for the market to stabilize and form clear reversal patterns before committing money.
expert_reasoning: Systematic review of all 7 candidates reveals no actionable setup. DEXE (-33.9% 7d) has Three Black Crows and chart bias -1.4 — classic falling knife. BONK RSI 29 is oversold (a reliable signal per our track record), but the bearish engulfing pattern, -26.5% 5-day momentum, and no identifiable support level make it untradeable. ENA shows an Evening Star reversal at -1.7 bias despite today's 10.3% bounce — likely a dead cat bounce. KAITO has the only bullish chart (+1.1) but RSI 87 screams overbought — the -3.9% daily move suggests the correction has begun. FET at RSI 38 in a downtrend with bearish engulfing offers poor risk/reward at 1.3x. Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening trend per Rule 3 supports holding. BTC dominance at 56.2% confirms capital is flowing away from alts, making alt entries especially risky.
risk_factors: Coldcard exploit ($89M) could expand further, triggering broader security panic and exchange withdrawals
Fear & Greed trend is worsening — could drop below 25 into extreme fear territory, pushing prices lower
High BTC dominance (56.2%) means altcoins face additional headwinds from capital rotation into Bitcoin
watch_list: Monitor ADA — up 14.6% this week against a bearish market; if it pulls back to support with volume confirmation, could become a swing entry
Watch for Fear & Greed to either capitulate below 20 (contrarian buy zone) or recover above 35 (sentiment stabilization)
Track Coldcard exploit developments — if losses are contained and funds recovered, the security overhang lifts
market_context: Crypto market is in a risk-off environment with Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening. A major hardware wallet exploit ($89M) and Trump Media BTC sales are adding selling pressure, while BTC dominance at 56.2% signals capital fleeing altcoins for relative safety.
context_banner: Bearish conditions across the board with no quality swing setups — capital preservation is the correct trade.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening trend suggests the market hasn't found a bottom yet — per validated Rule 3, ambiguous conditions favor holding.
BONK RSI at 29 (oversold) is our most reliable signal historically (71% win rate), but the bearish chart pattern and lack of support levels prevent acting on it alone.
Coldcard exploit spreading to 4,500 addresses with $89M losses is the biggest hardware wallet hack since FTX era — a significant negative catalyst shaking market confidence.
Trump Media selling 2,628 BTC (holdings down to 4,261 BTC) adds institutional sell pressure to an already weak market.
No volume breakout patterns detected across any candidate — all moves are occurring on unremarkable volume, suggesting no institutional accumulation.
